description: Wait for a person to approve or reject a held action in the AtlaSent console. Use the approval_request_id from a 'hold' result. This tool cannot approve anything; it only waits. If approved, it returns a permit_token that you MUST verify with atlasent_verify_permit before running the action. Any other outcome (rejected, expired, timed out) means the action must not run.

approval_request_id.description: The approval_request_id from a 'hold' evaluate result.

change_plan.description: Your CURRENT change plan, if it changed since the action was evaluated. Omit it to present the plan this server evaluated. It is only a declaration: the approved plan is what runs unless a person approves the new one.

artifact_ref.description: Built artifact that will run (e.g. an image digest).

operation.description: What kind of change (e.g. deploy, rollback, apply).

revision.description: Source/config revision that will run (e.g. a git SHA).

max_wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for a decision (default 120, max 900).

on_plan_mismatch.description: If your plan differs from the approved one: 'rerequest' (default) files ONE linked re-request for your plan and keeps waiting; 'use_approved' claims the approved plan instead and returns it so you run exactly that.

name: atlasent_await_approval
title: AtlaSent — Wait for Human Approval
